Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

protect verb

also keep safe, shield, defend, guard, protection, shelter from, defence, defense

classical

Mor. 14: oppositāque manū lūmen dēfendit ab aurā
Traupman 302

dēfendō, dēfendere, dēfendī, dēfēnsum

verb, third conjugation, transitive; with ab and the ablative

protect, defend; keep (harm) off

To protect someone from something is aliquem ab aliquā rē dēfendere; the harm kept off can also be the object, as in frīgus et sōlem dēfendere (Cato Agr. 48.2, Lewis & Short).

Other words

  • tueor, tuērī, tuitus sum — keep safe, guard; look after

    verb, second conjugation, deponent, transitive · also used · classical · Phaedr. 3.7.9–10: custōs ut sīs līminis, ā fūribus tueāris et noctū domum

    See also maintain and provide for.

  • prōtegō, prōtegere, prōtēxī, prōtēctum — cover, shield

    verb, third conjugation, transitive · also used · classical · Vulg. Ps. 16 (17), 8: Sub umbrā ālārum tuārum prōtege mē; Verg. G. 2.489: ingentī rāmōrum prōtegat umbrā

  • custōdiō, custōdīre, custōdīvī, custōdītum — guard, keep safe

    verb, fourth conjugation, transitive · also used · classical · Vulg. Num. 6.24: Benedīcat tibi Dominus, et custōdiat tē.; Traupman 195: guard

  • praesidium, praesidiī n. — protection, safeguard

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Nep. Ages. 3 (Lewis & Short): praesidiō suīs

    To protect someone is also alicuī praesidiō esse (Lewis & Short).

Examples

  • tandem conceptō, sed vix, fulgōre recēdit, oppositāque manū lūmen dēfendit ab aurā

    At last, when the flame has caught (only just), he steps back and shields the light from the draught with his hand.Mor. 13–14

  • custōdī mē ut pūpillam oculī. Sub umbrā ālārum tuārum prōtege mē

    Keep me as the apple of your eye; protect me under the shadow of your wings.Vulg. Ps. 16 (17), 8

  • custōs ut sīs līminis, ā fūribus tueāris et noctū domum

    Just guard the door, and keep the house safe from thieves at night.Phaedr. 3.7.9–10

See also guard, avoid, keep watch, save, shield, shelter.
